summary: The change rejects explicit-null, reasoning-only Cerebras completions and adds focused coverage for the documented 502 behavior.

evidence: src/provider/cerebras.ts:502-503 now treats both omitted and explicit null content as no payload when no tool call or refusal exists, causing normalization to fail closed.
tests/openai-compat-part11.test.ts:711-718 covers a content:null, finish_reason:length, reasoning-only Cerebras response and asserts the 502 cerebras_upstream_invalid_response result.
